title: Research the edge-inference mechanism and verify claims

acceptance.claims: Every factual claim has a source and confidence label.
acceptance.counterevidence: At least one competing explanation or limitation is recorded.

title: Develop competing story and visual concepts

acceptance.diversity: Each direction has a distinct narrative mechanism and visual grammar.

title: Choose a direction and build an evidence-bound story/shot plan

acceptance.narrative: The opening promise, mechanism, escalation and payoff are explicit.
acceptance.traceability: Every factual beat is linked to evidence and every beat has a visual expression.

title: Create a 3-12 second near-final sample of the riskiest visual idea

acceptance.craft: The sample is a credible fragment of the intended final video, not a technical placeholder.

title: Produce independent shot groups using the best admissible medium per shot

acceptance.coverage: Every planned beat has usable shot material.
acceptance.continuity: Identity, props, motion and world rules are checked where relevant.

title: Create narration, music and sound design as a coordinated layer

acceptance.audio: Narration is intelligible; music and effects support rather than mask the story.

title: Assemble the master cut and conform sound, captions and pacing

acceptance.story: No dead time; the ending pays off the opening promise.
acceptance.delivery: All declared candidate deliverables are present.

title: Independently review the exact candidate for editorial and audiovisual craft

acceptance.review: The review cites exact artifact digests and evidence, with PASS/REVISE/FAIL per rubric.

title: Run deterministic media QA on the exact final candidate bytes

acceptance.technical: Streams, duration, frame rate, resolution, audio and playback pass the brief.

title: Assemble release decision evidence for the exact master and platform package

acceptance.release: All brief-specific editorial, craft, technical, rights and platform gates are independently evidenced; remaining blockers are explicit.
